product_total = df_grouped.groupby('product')['total_revenue'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
product_order = product_total.index.tolist()

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
plt.title('Total Revenue by Product and Size')
plt.legend(title='Size')
